candidates.label: Divorce at the waiting period's commencement with housing protection and limit-transgression warning
candidates.definition: In 65:1: O Prophet when you divorce women divorce them for the commencement of their waiting period and keep count of the waiting period and fear Allah your Lord; do not turn them out of their houses nor should they leave during that period unless they are committing a clear immorality; and those are the limits set by Allah; and whoever transgresses the limits of Allah has certainly wronged himself.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ إِذَا طَلَّقۡتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحۡصُواْ ٱلۡعِدَّةَۖ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمۡۖ لَا تُخۡرِجُوهُنَّ مِنۢ بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخۡرُجۡنَ إِلَّآ أَن يَأۡتِينَ بِفَٰحِشَةٖ مُّبَيِّنَةٖۚ وَتِلۡكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِۚ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ فَقَدۡ ظَلَمَ نَفۡسَهُۥۚ لَا تَدۡرِي لَعَلَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحۡدِثُ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ أَمۡرٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Way out and unexpected provision for whoever fears Allah and relies upon Him
candidates.definition: In 65:2-3: And whoever fears Allah He will make for him a way out and will provide for him from where he does not expect; and whoever relies upon Allah then He is sufficient for him; indeed Allah will accomplish His purpose.

evidence.excerpt: فَإِذَا بَلَغۡنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمۡسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعۡرُوفٍ أَوۡ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعۡرُوفٖ وَأَشۡهِدُواْ ذَوَيۡ عَدۡلٖ مِّنكُمۡ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلشَّهَٰدَةَ لِلَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ مَخۡرَجٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَيَرۡزُقۡهُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَحۡتَسِبُۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسۡبُهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَٰلِغُ أَمۡرِهِۦۚ قَدۡ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدۡرٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Differentiated waiting periods for post-menopausal, non-menstruating and pregnant women
candidates.definition: In 65:4: And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women if you doubt then their period is three months and also for those who have not menstruated; and for those who are pregnant their term is until they give birth.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱلَّـٰٓـِٔي يَئِسۡنَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَآئِكُمۡ إِنِ ٱرۡتَبۡتُمۡ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَٰثَةُ أَشۡهُرٖ وَٱلَّـٰٓـِٔي لَمۡ يَحِضۡنَۚ وَأُوْلَٰتُ ٱلۡأَحۡمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَن يَضَعۡنَ حَمۡلَهُنَّۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ مِنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦ يُسۡرٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Capacity-based financial obligation with ease following hardship
candidates.definition: In 65:7: Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth and he whose provision is restricted let him spend from what Allah has given him; Allah does not charge a soul except according to what He has given it; Allah will bring about after hardship ease.

evidence.excerpt: لِيُنفِقۡ ذُو سَعَةٖ مِّن سَعَتِهِۦۖ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقُهُۥ فَلۡيُنفِقۡ مِمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُۚ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا مَآ ءَاتَىٰهَاۚ سَيَجۡعَلُ ٱللَّهُ بَعۡدَ عُسۡرٖ يُسۡرٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Insolent cities brought to severe account tasting the evil consequence of their affair
candidates.definition: In 65:8-9: And how many a city was insolent toward the command of its Lord and His messengers so We took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment; and it tasted the bad consequence of its affair and the outcome of its affair was loss.

evidence.excerpt: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ عَتَتۡ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِۦ فَحَاسَبۡنَٰهَا حِسَابٗا شَدِيدٗا وَعَذَّبۡنَٰهَا عَذَابٗا نُّكۡرٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: فَذَاقَتۡ وَبَالَ أَمۡرِهَا وَكَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ أَمۡرِهَا خُسۡرًا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Messenger reciting distinct verses bringing believers from darknesses into light
candidates.definition: In 65:11: A Messenger reciting to you the distinct verses of Allah that He may bring out those who believe and do righteous deeds from darknesses into the light.

evidence.excerpt: رَّسُولٗا يَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ مُبَيِّنَٰتٖ لِّيُخۡرِجَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِۚ وَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعۡمَلۡ صَٰلِحٗا يُدۡخِلۡهُ جَنَّـٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۖ قَدۡ أَحۡسَنَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ رِزۡقًا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Seven heavens and earths with descending command demonstrating competence and comprehensive knowledge
candidates.definition: In 65:12: It is Allah who has created seven heavens and of the earth the like of them; His command descends among them so you may know that Allah is over all things competent and that Allah has encompassed all things in knowledge.

evidence.excerpt: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖ وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِثۡلَهُنَّۖ يَتَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ بَيۡنَهُنَّ لِتَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدۡ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمَۢا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.
